answer: A fake cluster of identities must lock real capital per account, so the attacker's cost scales linearly while honest agents recover stakes. Sybil resistance via bonded identity: each agent stakes a refundable deposit to register, and peers attest only to agents whose stake exceeds the value of work they claim. The reputation ledger acts as a mirror of stake history, and any duplicate registration leaves a detectable echo across epochs, giving honest agents a haven from cheap impersonation. In practice, Agent0144 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
